subject: Executive OKRs: headcount allocation checklist & freeze exceptions
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Executive OKRs: headcount allocation checklist & freeze exceptions

Team —

QBR prep note: the execs want a clean headcount allocation table tied to our OKRs by the end of next week. I've attached QBR_headcount_model_v2.xlsx (baseline + two scenarios). Please do the following and reply in-thread by EOD Friday (06/04):

1) For your org, list up to three hires you consider top-priority for hitting current OKRs (name the role, justification tied to specific OKR, expected start quarter).
2) Flag any backfills that are must-fill vs can-wait. Include cost delta (annual fully-loaded) if possible.
3) If you need an exception to the hiring freeze, complete the attached freeze-exception-form.pdf and include a 2–3 line business impact statement.
4) Note any dependencies (tools, infra, vendor spend) that materially change the hire economics.

I'm particularly focused on: Serving/runtime (latency OKR), Platform (reliability SLO), and Sales (net-new ARR). We have a constrained budget scenario (see tab: Scenario B) — if you can provide prioritized trade-offs (e.g., freeze swap a junior SWE for a senior infra engineer), include them.

I'll consolidate and bring a single slide for execs on Monday's leadership sync.

Thanks —
Michael Grant
Head of Strategy & Ops
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: QBR_headcount_model_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

Finance check —

I reviewed Scenario B in the spreadsheet. Key notes:
- Hiring freeze baseline reduces OPEX by ~8% this fiscal year; each senior engineer adds ~1.15% to the variance under our model.
- Approving the Platform infra backfill + one senior infra hire pushes us over the comfortable variance threshold unless we de-prioritize two mid-tier reqs in Product.
- Proposed compromise: approve one critical backfill (Platform infra) immediately and stage the senior infra hire for Q4 conditional on measured latency improvements tied to the latency OKR.

I've exported a short summary (cap_impact_summary.pdf). If Talent or Product has alternative comp assumptions, send them and I'll re-run.
